prompt: What is the effect of the line directory "/home/sam/bind"; found in the options section of an /etc/named.conf file?
choices: It tells BIND to chroot into /home/sam/bind on startup.
It tells BIND to look in the /home/sam/bind directory for its zone files.
It tells BIND to log all queries to /home/sam/bind.
It restricts queries to clients in /home/sam/bind.
explanation: The directory option sets the working directory; relative zone-file paths in named.conf are resolved from /home/sam/bind.
